properties.content: Question: did maria shriver divorce arnold Answer: Yes, Maria Shriver and Arnold Schwarzenegger divorced. Maria Shriver filed for divorce in July 2011, after 25 years of marriage, due to Schwarzenegger's affair and subsequent revelation that he had fathered a child with their housekeeper, Mildred Baena, according to People.com. Their divorce was finalized in December 2021, ten years after their separation, according to NBC News.
